title: New Resident Evil Reboot Film Earns US$400 Million Globally
content: According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned US$399,998,502 globally: US$157,398,502 in the United States and US$242,600,000 internationally. The film ranked at #7 in the U.S. last weekend, earning an estimated US$2,525,000 from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Voltage, Toei Animation Reveal Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi Otome Game For Release in 2027 on Switch
content: Game developer Voltage announced on Monday it and Toei Animation are developing the Kakan Ruirui: The Caged Lantern of Yomi (Kakan Ruirui: Urayomi Terasu Hōzukiyo) otome game for a scheduled digital release on Nintendo Switch in 2027. Voltage is releasing the game as part of its console brand AmuLit.
author: ANN

title: Toshihiro Nagoshi's Nagoshi Studio Shuts Down
content: NetEase Games had announced the formation of Nagoshi Studio Inc. in January 2022. The studio announced its first game Gang of Dragon during The Game Awards in December 2025. Bloomberg then reported in March 2026 that a NetEase spokesperson confirmed it will stop financing the studio.
author: ANN

title: Opera Manga Magazine Announces Shift to Digital Publication
content: The editorial department for Akaneshinsha 's Opera magazine announced on X (formerly Twitter ) the magazine will switch to a digital format following the release of its 100th and final print issue on Friday. The first digital-only issue will launch in spring 2027.
author: ANN

title: 2026 Today's Korean Comics Awards Announce 5 Winners
content: The Korea Cartoonist Association and South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (MCST) announced the five winners of the 2026 “Today's Korean Comics” awards on October 20.
